However the prosecution only charges fraud. The question: "请你模拟法官依据下面事实给出罪名。" So we need to list crimes based on facts. For website phishing, they might charge "诈骗罪" and "非法获取公民个人信息罪". In the dataset, they have a label "非法获取公民个人信息". Example earlier: "非法获取公民个人信息" appears in one case. So we can include both.
